method.description: Fixed-model probability-scale interventional Kernel SHAP repeated-run study on real UCI German Credit and official ACS PUMS2024 California, using actual folktables ACSIncome definition. Three model families: logistic(C1,max_iter200), forest(64 trees,depth6), boosting(64 stages,depth3). Training-only imputation/scaling and one-hot encoding, grouped by original columns. Original raw predictors are normalized before harmonization/extraction; NFKC, collapsed whitespace, canonical Decimal numbers and signed zero; duplicate original and harmonized predictors grouped before hash partitioning. Explicit ACS2024 RELSHIPP-to-RELP adapter follows official dictionary; retained original RELSHIPP, original-predictor and full-original-record hashes, harmonized-predictor hashes and row provenance. Hash groups use approximately40/60 search/final and60/20/20 train/validation/explain, with source-order caps ACS train5000/10000 and validation/explain3000 per plane; hash splitting approximates stratification rather than guaranteeing exact class counts. Two distinct source IDs or directories never establish disjointness; staging checks every selected original/full/harmonized content hash intersection. Backgrounds8,32 reuse training rows only. Models fit afresh per statistical seed. Within a fit/input/background, only explainer randomness varies. Search6 explained inputs per case,3 repeats at64/256 query budgets; final12 inputs,6 repeats. Six real cases per seed plus a control suite. Four additional independent64-query runs averaged versus the first256-query run have equal total query budget; this is not a single run. Two independent SHAP KernelExplainer references at2048 including endpoints and an independent deployment SHAP baseline at each rung; ACS exact1024 coalitions, six-feature synthetic exact64. Actual oracle rows and coalitions, including duplicate masks and all required baseline/reference calls, are counted. Model fitting occurs in required, killable evaluator workers before candidate work, so no baseline remains active during candidate calls. Candidate sees only unlabeled original inputs/backgrounds, group count, deployment budget, stream and its own model-query probabilities. No adaptation requirement, training-state claim, private labels, reference output, correctness feedback, fitted model, path or file transfer is permitted. Bounded dimensions20 players,32 background rows,256 masks per batch guarantee small complete JSON; large shapes are invalid, no logical large state exists, and therefore no chunk/state-transfer operation is declared. This refines the optional design fallback without relaxing the64MiB strict wire ceiling. reset exactly{op,seed} -> exactly{ok:true}; start -> exactly{masks}; observe -> exactly{phi}, all via handle. Every run has start+observe; oracle is evaluator-side. Shapley-kernel size sampling with uniform subsets and constrained least squares is exercised, not an alias. Every regression is recomputed from actual masks and oracle values with rcond1e-10, tolerance rtol1e-6/atol1e-7. This is a bounded behavioral/numerical check, not a proof of candidate hidden internals. Predeclared controls: constant model must yield zero and residual<1e-6; copy actual normal output to a distinct nondegenerate input, retaining perfect self-agreement but failing exact fidelity; strictly nonidentity permutation swaps unequal active coordinates and permutes model/input/background together before undoing attribution coordinates, agreeing with exact values at rtol1e-5/atol1e-6; terminal reset replays the entire first case deterministically. All approximate control branches use the actual candidate Kernel SHAP route and matched budgets, not names. Identity permutation or identical copy targets are rejected. Control streams are independent, fixed and equally budgeted; the additive case permits exact numerical expectations without stochastic claims. Every control is required and failed/missing controls receive0, never omitted. Candidate state_changed flags do not exist or contribute. Search eligibility: required reference/baseline readiness, valid wire/trace/feedback/isolation, nonvacuous controls and terminal replay; real-case timeouts retain penalties and lower score but are not an invented comparative veto. Malformed responses, reset failure, required baseline failure and failed controls fail eligibility. Final correct additionally requires all real cases complete and valid. Negative, conditional or inconclusive reliability findings are valid. Publication claims separately need supported bounded effects and uncertainty, not merely correct or a high score. No empirical reliability threshold is an eligibility gate, since task.md delegates research choices but specifies no comparative threshold. Aggregation: all repeat pairs equally per rung for top3-set overlap; all repeats equally for fidelity/local accuracy; budget rungs1/2, backgrounds1/2, inputs equal, models1/3 per dataset, datasets1/2, seeds equal. With all balanced levels present this equals the simple mean over fixed real-case means. Matched gain has only its actual input/background/model/dataset/seed levels. Top-k=min(3,d), stable feature-index ties. Rank=1 minus normalized Spearman footrule; sign uses abs<=1e-8 as zero. Discrepancy quality=1/(1+L1(phi-ref)/max(1e-8,L1(ref))). Fidelity averages the two reference qualities for German; ACS uses exact reference. Local quality=1/(1+abs(efficiency residual)/1e-6). Reference resolution quality compares the two independent high-budget refs, not a convergence certificate. Matched gain=quality(mean four64,ref)-quality(first256,ref), in[-1,1]. These descriptive metrics never reward a favorable scientific conclusion in combined_score. Scientific completeness is the equal-weight fraction of complete, valid real-case cells; a case failure conservatively fails all its cells and all its required output slots, even if partial work occurred. combined_score=1/2 scientific completeness + 1/2 control_pass_fraction. Four canonical categories constant/copy/permutation/reset have1/4 each, averaging suite probes/seeds within category, reset supplied by the sole terminal replay. Every absent bounded quality=0 and matched gain=-1; no renormalization. coverage counts each scheduled candidate run/reference/baseline/exact output and control check equally, including replay: per real cell2R+4 candidate outputs +4 SHAP outputs + one ACS exact output; control suite12R candidate outputs+6 exact outputs+3 checks. Case/replay failures retain all slots as missing. Input-cluster paired bootstrap200 draws yields descriptive95% percentile intervals within a fit; repeat pairs are not independent. Two final fits must be reported individually; few clusters, approximate German references and coarse synthetic tests limit claims. Evidence retains all returned attributions, references, actual costs/counters, control probes, all trace digests and the first full query/regression trace per case; it is not a complete raw mask archive. Missing cases are represented, not fabricated. No formal causal/high-risk-deployment safety claim follows. Environment: measured drafting Python3.12.15 Linuxx86_64, float64, CPU only, one aggregate core, evaluator4GiB/candidate2GiB; immutable source code may be shared but held-out examples may not. Production search ceiling5400s and final50400s include startup120s, setup/imports, fits, baselines, candidate oracle loops, scoring, output and cleanup. Primary episode caps600/3200s; matched baseline and candidate allowances260/1400s each, 2s cleanup each; controls each reserve one third of the same method allowance before starting. Global remaining reset reservations8s+3s per episode and finish30s prevent later diagnostic starvation. Cleanup reserve3s covers two sequential process terminate/kill waits(.5+.5s each) plus two reader teardowns(.4s each) and bookkeeping. Smoke uses the same paths/imports/topology and two primary episodes followed by the sole terminal replay, one input, background4, repeats2, budgets32/128 so four-times-low is exactly matched to high, references128, method9s, episode32s, RPC8s, reset4s, finish5s; invocation112s leaves an8s startup allowance within120s. Smoke episode cap32s includes reset4s, two(9s work+2s cleanup) methods and3s overhead. Smoke never proves production final feasibility. Reset sequence fields enumerate the complete global broker-visible ordered transcript, including the sole terminal deterministic replay of the first selected seed after all primary episodes; complete counts8/15 production and3/3 smoke. No additional resets/replay are allowed. All RPC operation-count rows including the replay sum to1760 search and10287 final, not the design provisional ceilings. Native smoke enforces Landlock/seccomp isolation and killable subprocesses; production exact broker path plus socket selects trusted in-process proxy, with no peer filesystem or unsupported telemetry. Qualification is independent of scientific performance, requires ordinary nonsmoke workload completion within bounds and no failed/missing required controls. Author kit: official NeurIPS2026 Formatting_Instructions_For_NeurIPS_2026.zip verified from2026 CallForPapers;9 content pages, acknowledgments/references/checklist/technical appendices excluded; kit contains neurips_2026.tex, neurips_2026.sty, checklist.tex. Preserve its actual terms, no invented license. No paper or literature results are manufactured by this scaffold. The one-week elapsed and estimated24CPU-hour campaign budget remain; at most3 search evaluations plus one final consume at most18.5 single-core hours, leaving staging/writing margin. No prohibited prior-paper search was done.

protocol.promotion_rule: Harness ranks search-eligible correct=true candidates by combined_score descending, earlier submission then frozen source SHA256 tie-break. At most three search evaluations. Freeze before sealed final. Search correct is evidence/integrity/control eligibility, final correct additionally requires complete final cases; no comparative reliability threshold. Each reset_sequence lists the complete global broker-visible transcript, including exactly one required terminal replay of its first seed after all primary episodes (totals8 search,15 final,3 each smoke). No additional resets are permitted. No controller is implemented here.

search_proxies.name: reduced_replication
search_proxies.preserves: Both real datasets, all three fitted model families, grouped Kernel SHAP, deployment query budgets, fixed references and four substantive control categories
search_proxies.omits: Search uses one fit seed, six inputs and three repeats; final uses disjoint raw examples, two seeds, twelve inputs and six repeats. Smoke reduces work only and never establishes final feasibility.

search_visible: Development-only aggregate search metrics and bounded search failure categories; permitted unlabeled inputs/backgrounds and own black-box model query values; no private labels or reference outputs
final_sealed: All final examples, fit seeds until freeze, private targets, references, outcomes, scalar metrics and detailed evidence remain sealed; never returned as optimization feedback

required_evidence: Frozen implementation, exact protocol, source asset checksums, normalization/split provenance and zero raw/predictor content overlap; no prohibited literature access

Completed sealed measurements for both main datasets and all three model families, fixed budgets/backgrounds, independent repeats, matched-budget averages and independently measured references with uncertainty

Evaluator-owned actual query/regression and constant/copy/nonidentity-permutation/reset evidence, all failures retained with fixed weights; negative/unresolved findings valid; state hashes or candidate flags are not learning evidence

Paired input-cluster uncertainty, sign/top-rank/tie/discrepancy/local-accuracy/reference-resolution and actual cost reporting; two fit seeds separately, no universal safety or causal feature-importance claims

Actual-result-only complete PDF and LaTeX in verified official NeurIPS2026 nine-content-page template, required checklist, genuine consulted citations, limitations and all code/environment/data/seeds/commands/table-figure traceability

Scientific validity, search eligibility and claim assessment are separate; correct=true is not automatic publication. Manuscript generation/review and full final productive feasibility are not certified by draft smoke.
